title: E-Sign envelopes cannot be cancelled, voided or deleted
fix_note: E-Sign envelopes gain esign-void + esign-delete (@24e6c0688 server, @460bbb0f7 FE). Void rides the domain's own pre-designed 'voided' status — esign-sign already refused to sign a voided envelope and binder-issue requires 'completed', so a voided envelope can never sign or bind; void sets status + voidedAt + an audit-trail event. Delete removes VOIDED envelopes only. Boundary named: a COMPLETED envelope is the fully-signed record and can be neither voided nor deleted. AmsWorkbench E-Sign tab: StickyDeleteConfirm Void on in-flight envelopes, Delete on voided ones. Server suite lifecycle-exits (2 insurance tests) + FE pin green; NC pristine-fails.

A retired deity leaves list/search and detail for everyone but its author (author detail shows the Retired flag); the record is kept so pilgrimage/blessing history still resolves. DeityDetailPanel: StickyDeleteConfirm Retire beside Revise for the author. Server + FE pins green; NC pristine-fails.

title: Will versions can't be deleted (Restore only)
fix_note: New delete_will_version verb (@24e6c0688 server, @460bbb0f7 FE). Refuses the ACTIVE version (cannot_delete_active_version — author a new will first); other versions are TOMBSTONED (status 'deleted', excluded from list, get/restore return version_not_found) rather than spliced, because version numbers are assigned as wills.length + 1 — splicing would let a later author_will reuse a live number (pinned: after deleting v1 the next authored will is v3). WillsPanel: StickyDeleteConfirm Delete on non-active rows via EstateContext.deleteWill.

fix_note: DELETE/ANNOTATE LEG ONLY (the ticket's no-search leg is the find genus, not claimed). New fishing catch-delete + catch-annotate verbs (@24e6c0688 server, @460bbb0f7 FE): owner-scoped DELETE/UPDATE on the caller's own player_inventory raw_fish rows (WHERE user_id = actor — another angler's catch id matches nothing); annotate merges a note into the row metadata JSON (blank clears). CatchLog gains a Note column + Add/Edit note editor + StickyDeleteConfirm Delete (label carries the stacked quantity, since repeat catches stack onto one row). Server suite lifecycle-exits-db ships for desk batch checks/CI — better-sqlite3 does not build in the Muse VM (CB-0447 frontier precedent); FE pins green locally, NC pristine-fails.

title: Houses can't be renamed, deleted or unclaimed

fix_note: New renameHouse + unclaimHouse in server/lib/player-housing.js (@24e6c0688) behind housing.rename / housing.unclaim macros, owner-scoped via the lib's _ownedHouse like every sibling. Rename validates non-empty <=120 chars; unclaim deletes the player_houses join row (claimHouse's inverse — the building can be claimed again). Named scope: world state the claim touched (building ownership, room furniture layouts) is world substrate and is NOT reverted by unclaim. MineHousesPanel: rename input + StickyDeleteConfirm 'Release house' on the selected house. Server suite lifecycle-exits-db ships for desk CI (better-sqlite3, as fishing-004); FE pins green, NC pristine-fails.
